worker_bootstrap.history_rule: Do not erase failed attempts after a later fix succeeds.
worker_bootstrap.parallel_rule: Workers must claim isolated roadmap steps or isolated subproblems and re-read the experiment index before writing.

fast.purpose: low-latency feedback for each ChatGPT-authored change

unity.purpose: engine import, compile, EditMode/runtime and platform verification

interaction_contract.explicit_continue_or_change_requests: create smallest auditable change and verify
interaction_contract.failed_fast_gate: record failure in experiment log, stop feature expansion, and inspect failure
interaction_contract.passed_fast_gate: record machine evidence and become eligible for next small iteration
interaction_contract.unity_blocked_only: continue pure-domain work but do not claim Unity integration
